identity.name: Boca Woods Country Club
identity.hoa_name: Boca Woods Country Club Association, Inc.
identity.notes: Gated single-family country club community in West Boca Raton along Boca Woods Lane (ZIP 33428), with about 645 homes built mainly in the 1980s, arranged around two golf courses. The HOA (established 07/22/1986; legal name BOCA WOODS COUNTRY CLUB ASSOCIATION, INC.; federal ID 592720777; address 10831 White Aspen Ln, Boca Raton FL 33428) maintains the gate, community pool, tennis courts, and common areas, while owners maintain their homes and yards. Property manager: FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota FL 34231, 941-960-5000. Third-party census-based data for the area: 6,476 residents, 2,245 households (avg 3 members), median construction year 1987, 53.9% Caucasian / 8.9% African American / 5.1% Asian, 49.6% male / 50.4% female, 16.7% age 65+, median housing cost ~$1,986/mo (truncated in source).

fees.note: No specific HOA dues amount stated in available web content. Sources direct buyers to contact the property manager (FPMS, 941-960-5000) or the board for current fees, budget, and reserve study; confirm assessment status for the specific home before purchase.

Full Golf annual dues 2025-2026: $25,045 to $25,543 depending on payment plan (6 or 12 months), plus 7% sales tax. Mandatory golf membership for most homes; some legacy homes may carry Social/Tennis-only membership (largely terminated to new purchasers). Effective March 3, 2026 per page (headline lists $150,000 total 2025-2026 fees). Realtor-published figures; verify with association (FPMS, 941-960-5000). Official HOA 'Schedule of Fees' PDFs (2022-2023, 2015-2016) exist on community/MLS media but could not be parsed (binary PDF). Confidence 0.6 (reputable listing, not official).

Associate Golf annual dues 2025-2026: $11,724 to $11,957 depending on payment plan (applies to family members over 25 still at home or a 3rd resident such as an in-law). Realtor-published; verify with association.
Monthly service charge $125 + tax (Single Service Charge $100 + tax). Realtor-published; verify with association.
Initiation fee for Full Golf membership, non-refundable (2025-2026). Realtor-published; verify with association.
Membership Certificate (Full Golf), $1,000, refundable upon future sale of the home. Realtor-published; verify with association.
Annual dining room minimum: $2,000 + tax per membership ($1,000 + tax per single membership). Realtor-published; verify with association.

Monthly capital assessments for golf members: $84.00 (Golf Facilities Enhancement 2018) + $98.00 (Woods Course 2023 Assessment) = $182.00/mo. Social/Tennis members pay $50.40 + $58.80 = $109.20/mo. These are club capital assessments, not CDD assessments. Realtor-published; verify with association.
